body.statement: A pair \(\{c,d\}\subset C\) is coordinate-isolated at \(r\in V\) if and only if its endpoints are the baseline and the perfect intervention on a root \(r\); for any third component, exactly the baseline endpoint has the same \(r\)-th marginal variance as that third component.
body.justification: This is the permutation-equivariant replacement for minimizing pairwise rank sums.
body.gap: Proposition 10 of Squires et al. attempts baseline recovery from ranks; no cited result characterizes baseline-root pairs by exact coordinate support and orients them by an invariant marginal.
body.consumer: Theorem 1 obtains the baseline without faithfulness, a known root, or an externally supplied observational sample.
